title: PregOutfit 솔로 #019 · 임산부풀텀트윈즈 · 레이싱퀸 · glossy coral-red lips
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Filipina woman, an adult, in her mid 30s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term multiples pregnancy. Her pregnant belly is exceptionally wide as well as high, stretched into a broad, taut, smoothly rounded dome far wider than an ordinary single pregnancy, the navel pushed flat and outward at its highest point, faint linea nigra running down its centre. A full heavy bust above it, wide round hips below, soft thick thighs and arms. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive rounded middle. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, warm tan skin, heavy sculpted contour and a glowing highlighter on the cheekbones, smoky bronze and gold glitter eyeshadow, dramatic long lashes, defined dark brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy coral-red lips, a bright, confident pageant smile, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in a low chignon knot at the nape, real pores, real living eyes, 8 hoops piercings set with opals in rose-gold-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of rose-gold an anklet. Wearing a minimal white and red racing-queen costume of a tiny cropped top of two small opaque cups with a bold red stripe, a white low-rise micro-mini skirt with a red stripe at the very top of her thighs and a small white racing cap, fully opaque and covering only what it must, the bottom worn low on her hips beneath the lower curve of her belly, her pregnant belly fully bare above it. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme white and red extreme platform stiletto pumps, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Her pregnant belly is the visible centerpiece of the frame. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
